en: Sepia-toned reproduction of a medieval/early Renaissance religious fresco or panel painting showing two softly modeled angels in flowing robes, flying diagonally across a cracked, aged painted surface. Their feathered wings and drapery are elaborately detailed, and they appear within a curved architectural or celestial setting. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom typical of art-reproduction postcards.
